audience: founders, creators, consultants who track habits and execution
visual_system: POV photo from above, muted pavement texture, bold white activity title, script accent word, transparent giant background word, metric chips, small brand mark/footer
color_feel: neutral concrete gray, white, small red tag, blue gradient footer
interaction_layer: poll or slider: 'Cuanto avanzaste hoy?' / 'Estas midiendo tus leads?'
onia_adaptation: use for ONIA daily execution stories: 'Activity on Tuesday' becomes 'Leads on Tuesday'; replace distance/pace with leads captured, follow-ups sent, meetings booked
notes: Use when Hermes wants a lightweight story that proves movement without sounding like an ad.

visual_system: four-photo grid collage, lifestyle snapshots, centered time and bold routine label, natural light, no heavy graphics
color_feel: warm daylight, black gym tones, white overlay text
interaction_layer: question sticker: 'Que estas construyendo hoy?' or 'Quieres que te mande mi checklist?'
onia_adaptation: use for stories like '9:30 am BUILDING SYSTEMS': coffee, dashboard, Telegram bot, Notion, client workflow; make the brand feel active and human
notes: Good for making ONIA feel operated by real people, not only automation screenshots.

topic: aesthetic photo strip / quiet lifestyle sequence
audience: visual-first followers, founders who like understated content
visual_system: vertical stack of three candid photos, low contrast indoor tones, no headline, fashion/editorial spacing, neutral gray-black palette
color_feel: charcoal, faded denim gray, black leather, warm skin tones
interaction_layer: minimal emoji slider or tiny caption: 'work mode' / 'systems day'
onia_adaptation: use as a quiet story sequence showing workspace details: laptop, notes, dashboard close-up, coffee, terminal; avoid over-explaining
notes: This is a mood reference, not a copywriting reference. Use restraint.

audience: followers who like practical breakdowns and aesthetic annotations
visual_system: dark POV photo, large bold stacked headline, tiny spaced day label, handwritten notes, curved arrows pointing to details, small palette swatch, bottom hashtag
color_feel: dark asphalt, white, deep blue accent
interaction_layer: quiz or poll: 'Que parte falta en tu sistema?' with options like Captura, Seguimiento, Cierre
onia_adaptation: translate outfit-check structure into 'Sistema check': arrow to WhatsApp inbox, arrow to CRM, arrow to automation, arrow to dashboard; use blue/green ONIA accent palette
notes: Strongest story reference for educational ONIA content because annotations can explain systems quickly.

topic: work session mood / cafe desk ambience
visual_system: warm cafe photo, laptop and coffee, centered day/date typography, faux music player sticker, cinematic yellow-green color grade
color_feel: warm amber, green shadows, white text, dark translucent music card
interaction_layer: music sticker, question sticker: 'Quieres que convierta esto en sistema?'
onia_adaptation: use for 'Saturday building systems' stories: show laptop/dashboard, add music sticker aesthetic, subtle caption about building automations for clients
notes: Great for making technical work feel aspirational and modern.
